result.rationale: The migration line `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` will raise NoMethodError on nil when the site_settings table has no row for embed_category (fresh/default installs never changed that setting, so no row exists). The `if category_id == 0` fallback can never rescue this since the crash occurs before it. Same unguarded pattern at the embeddable_hosts read, though that one is guarded only by `embeddable_hosts && embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` after accessing `[0]['value']` via the conditional — actually that one checks presence, but the category_id que

judged_text: Migration crashes with NoMethodError on any site that never set embed_category: in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, execute(...)[0]['id'] INNER JOINs site_settings on name = 'embed_category', but Discourse only writes site_settings rows for explicitly-changed settings, so in the default case the result set is empty, [0] is nil, and nil['id'] raises, aborting db:migrate and blocking deploy/boot for most upgrading installs; the if category_id == 0 fallback is unreachable, and line 15 has the same unguarded [0]['value'] pattern.
